name: Minamoto Iori
source:
"Fufu, if someone like you were to go outside, it would be terrible. Something bad will happen."

He is a member of the Minamoto clan, one of Japan's leading conglomerates, and the founder of Ieva Girls' School. He may look like a 14 year old boy, but he's actually 24.

He is an arrogant man with a reckless attitude, but his sweetness also makes him a good-natured person.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/chouchoujiken/chara/index4.php]offiical website[/url]]
